name: export-workday-soap-invoice-mapping
summary: Workday Submit_Supplier_Invoice declarative SOAP mapping skeleton — reference-ID header projections, $IF_SCHEMA_ID$-guarded optional refs, amount-coded lines with worktags.

api_version.description: Workday SOAP API version, e.g. v42.2

provenance: Harvested 2026-07-03 from two independent production Workday AP implementations, both running the Rossum-hosted Workday SOAP connector; header + non-PO line shape near-identical in both. Not yet re-validated on a third tenant.
notes: Hook is a webhook (not a function) on annotation_content.export with config.url = {org}/svc/workday/api/v1/export; secrets are workday_username + workday_password (WS-Security as <username>@<tenant>; the connector never writes secrets back, so a closed secrets_schema is correct — workday-reference#credentials-and-secrets). The FIRST configurations[] entry matching the annotation's queue fires; no match = silent no-op (HTTP 200, no message). Export top-level keys are NOT validated (only the request/wsdl blocks are strict) — mistype queues as queue when scoping an entry and the typo is silently dropped, making the entry match EVERY queue (workday-reference#hook-wiring). Every optional reference is $IF_SCHEMA_ID$-wrapped with fallback_mapping {} so absent fields drop out instead of sending empty references; a plain @{field} that is missing fails the export with a message naming the schema id. Reference-ID types (Organization_Reference_ID, Supplier_ID, ...) and worktag types are tenant configuration — verify against the tenant. Full DSL grammar: workday-reference#the-mapping-dsl. EXTENSION POINTS — the skeleton is self-contained and assumes neither child: (1) Invoice_Line_Replacement_Data defaults to the inline non-PO amount+worktags block; swap in export-workday-po-line-type-projection for PO-based invoices. (2) Attachment_Data defaults to the inline single source document; swap in export-workday-soap-attachment-data for multi-document attachment. Attachment sizing: no connector-side cap — ceilings are Workday tenant limits and hook timeout (base64 +~33%; a slow submit can time out platform-side AFTER Workday created the invoice; Add_Only guards the retry). Business_Process_Parameters carries submit/approval routing (Auto_Complete, approver reference). CANDIDATE: verify the wsdl block and the tenant's reference-ID scheme on a live tenant before promoting.
